opening: These questions will help the nurse prepare for your home visit. Answer what you can and leave anything you are unsure about. This questionnaire does not replace the assessment. Your visit can still go ahead if you do not complete it.
closing: Thank you. The nurse will review your answers before the visit.

sections.intro: Your answers and any documents or photographs you upload will form part of the care record. They will be used by the visiting nurse and the clinical team arranging the care. Relevant information may also be shared with the care professional assigned to you when they need it to provide care. We will not use or share this information for another purpose without your permission, unless the law requires us to. You may ask to access or correct your information and, where applicable, ask us to delete it. Please see our privacy notice for details.
